spans.s: , how great? how large? how far? how much? of what extent? of what qualities? RV.; AV. &c. (Ved. loc. कि॑याति with following आ॑, how long ago? since what time? RV. i, 113, 10; ii, 30, 1; कियत्य् अध्वनि, at what distance? how far off? MBh. xiv, 766; कियद् एतद्, of what importance is this to (gen.), Kathās. iii, 49; तेन कियान् अर्थः, what profit arises from that? BhP.; कियच् चिरम् ind. how long? Kathās.; कियच् चिरेण, in how long a time? how soon? Śak.; कियद् दूरे, how far? Pañcat. lii, 4; कियद् रोदिमि, what is the use of my weeping? Kād.; कियद् असुभिस्, what is the use of living? BhP. i, 13, 22)

little, small, unimportant, of small value (often in comp., e.g. कियद्-वक्र, a little bent Comm. on Yājñ.; कियद् अपि, how large or how far soever, Pañcat.; या॑वत् कि॑यच् च, how large or how much soever, of what qualities soever, AV. viii, 7, 13; ŚBr.)
how far? how much? how? RV.; AV.; ŚBr.
कियत्—कालम् ind. how long? some little time ago.
कियद्—एतिका or कियद्—एहिका, f. effort, vigorous or persevering exertions according to one's strength, L.
कियद्—एतिका or कियद्—एहिका, f. effort, vigorous or persevering exertions according to one's strength, L.
कियद्—दूर n. ‘what distance?’, see -दूरे above s.v. कि॑यत्
‘some small distance’, (˚रे ind., अम् ind., or in comp.) ind. not far, a little way, Hit.
कियद्—दूरे ind., not far, a little way, Hit.
कियद्—दूरम् ind., not far, a little way, Hit.
कियन्—मात्र mfn. of little importance, Pañcat.
कियन्—मात्र n. trifle, small matter, Kathās. lxv, 139.
(for कियद्-धा॑) containing or surrounding much (N. of Indra), RV. i, 61, 6 and 12 (Nir. vi, 20).
a kind of aquatic plant (= क्या॑म्बू), RV. x, 16, 13.
